test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some teachers are dancers.

All dancers are beautiful.

All teachers are honest.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some teachers are beautiful.

II. Some dancers are honest.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some teachers are dancers.

All dancers are beautiful.

All teachers are honest.

The least possible Venn diagram is given:

Conclusions:

I. Some teachers are beautiful - &l
